scope: Shoppable photos, product imagery, image sequence, on-image copy and caption. Music is added on TikTok; music production is excluded.

sources.title: How to Create Shoppable Photos
sources.inspection: Opened page body including feature overview, best practices and FAQ; no original post viewing.
supports: US beta for selected sellers; at least two images and optional music
Clear product imagery, concise readable benefits and matching product tags
limits: Does not establish this account's eligibility
Platform-selected performance examples are not independently auditable causal evidence

sources.title: Image Ads | Carousel Ads Playbook
sources.inspection: PDF text, primarily pages 7 and 8 (one-based); publication date not confirmed.
supports: Use-case-led opening, narrative progression, benefits before CTA
Readable concise overlay, product visibility and safe-zone awareness
limits: Paid-ad guidance is not organic shoppable-photo evidence
Do not transfer image-count performance claims or older specifications as universal rules
transfer_hypotheses: Opening and sequence principles may be tested in organic photos

sources.title: Product Detail Pages & Listing Quality Guidelines
supports: PDP main image should clearly show the product without covering promotional elements
Guideline explicitly excludes digital renderings in PDP image validity
limits: PDP guidance must not be applied indiscriminately to organic posts
AI marketing images must not be labelled PDP compliant by default

sources.title: Product Page UX: All Products Need at Least One In Scale Image
sources.author: Christian Holst
sources.inspection: Opened study findings and scale-reference discussion.
supports: Known-size objects, people or environment help shoppers judge product scale
limits: Product-page usability does not establish TikTok conversion lift
Generated scale references require real dimensions and proportion checks
transfer_hypotheses: Scale proof may answer purchase uncertainty in shoppable photos

sources.title: UX Guidelines for Ecommerce Product Pages
sources.author: Katie Sherwin
sources.inspection: Opened product-information guidance and detailed bag-image shopping observation.
supports: Detailed product images help buyers assess suitability and compare products
limits: Observations are not an experiment proving a carousel sequence or social-commerce conversion
transfer_hypotheses: Each image should resolve a specific buying question

sources.title: Photos as Web Content
sources.author: Jakob Nielsen
sources.inspection: Opened informational versus decorative imagery discussion; updated date is page's last-reviewed date.
supports: Information-carrying imagery receives different attention than irrelevant decoration
limits: Web attention is not purchase causality
Does not mean all people, aesthetics or AI imagery should be rejected
transfer_hypotheses: People and context should serve product understanding

sources.title: How to be specific in your copywriting
sources.author: Joanna Wiebe
sources.inspection: Read tutorial transcript; published_at represents stated live presentation date, not verified page publication date.
supports: Edit vague summaries into specific meaning readers can imagine in their own lives
Customer-language research precedes drafting; concise does not always mean fewer words
limits: Practitioner method is not a TikTok sales experiment
Do not transfer email conversion anecdote or invent voice-of-customer evidence
transfer_hypotheses: Separate useful specificity from empty slogans in overlay and caption

sources.title: How Does Product Copy Format Affect User Engagement? Original Research
sources.author: Ben Labay
sources.inspection: Read setup and results: three product classes, three formats, at least 42 participants per combination.
supports: Attention to specification-copy formatting varies by product class
limits: Measures visual attention rather than sales
Does not support a universal long-copy, bullet-point or short-copy rule
transfer_hypotheses: Choose copy form by buying task and test it, rather than enforce brevity mechanically
